notes:
2026-09-12 (bugfix follow-up): user reported no artifacts visible on fin/22's replay board despite the scenario claiming 2 real artifacts present. Root cause: the migration's own scenarios.ts placed Phoenix Down/Elixir directly onto the battlefield via `pilot.state.addCard(...)` but never logged a matching `enters` entry for either — the replay UI (`app/lib/scenarioReplay.ts`) only seeds a card from a real log entry naming it; the scenario's later `read:isArtifact` entries alone register a bystander in the 'Unknown' zone (default arg of `ensure(target)` in the `read:*` fallback case), not 'Battlefield', so both artifacts were computed correctly but never rendered. This is NOT the Restoration Magic/GENERIC_FILLER_ARTIFACT bug (that was a synthetic-name-vs-real-card mismatch on the `artifactsCount` numeric-count path) — Gaelicat's scenario always used two real named fin Artifacts, never `artifactsCount`, and `GENERIC_FILLER_ARTIFACT` isn't involved at all here. The real, already-established fix pattern (aerith-gainsborough/scenarios.ts's own header comment: 'A real `enters` entry for each bystander — without one, it never shows up on the replay board at all') simply hadn't been applied when this scenario was authored. Fix: added `pilot.log.push({ fn: 'enters', card: ..., zone: 'Battlefield' })` for both Phoenix Down and Elixir right after they're placed. Regenerated trace.json (`run-scenarios.mjs --slug=gaelicat`) — verify-synergy.mjs (scoped): 0 hard failures (only the pre-existing benign tapForMana soft note). verify-synergy.mjs (full pool): 8 hard failures, all pre-existing/unrelated to this change (cargo-ship, cecil-dark-knight-cecil-redeemed-paladin, dragoon-s-wyvern, il-mheg-pixie, stiltzkin-moogle-merchant, the-wind-crystal, white-auracite, zack-fair — all already dirty in git status from a concurrent session before this task started; gaelicat itself is a soft `note`, not a `FAIL`). vitest run functional-model: 243/243 passed. Verified live in a real browser (Playwright against the dev server) at /app/card/fin/22's Scenarios tab: stepping to action 1 ('Real artifacts already on the battlefield') now shows Phoenix Down and Elixir as real card chips (their own real art) on your battlefield alongside the 3 Plains, confirming the fix. review reset to 'ai' (authored-content change to scenarios.ts/trace.json). No engine-behavior change — the underlying threshold-CDA gap (see knownGaps below) is untouched; this was purely a scenario-authoring/replay-visibility bug. Original migration notes preserved below.

2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/1-20 rollout continuation), per SYNERGY_DESIGN.md. Real oracle text confirmed against data/fin/fin_scryfall.json (collector_number 22): '{2}{W}', Creature — Cat, 1/3, 'Flying, vigilance / As long as you control two or more artifacts, this creature gets +2/+0.' Flying/Vigilance are bare printed keywords with no grant/broadcast involved — per this session's standing rule, neither gets a Fact. Added baseline `self-cast`/`self-enters` facts (typeLine-anchored, real {2}{W} cost/Hand origin checked against definition.ts — no alt-cost/flashback wrinkle). The real interesting clause ('As long as you control two or more artifacts, gets +2/+0') is a threshold-gated layer-7a CDA — checked adelbert-steiner's own synergy.json/definition.ts directly as precedent (the closest real 'continuous static pump gated on board-state count' in the pool) before authoring: unlike Steiner's own count-SCALING `ptFormula` (`addPerEquipmentControlled`, no threshold), Gaelicat's is a fixed on/off THRESHOLD, a shape this engine's `ptFormula` has no variant for (card.ts's own doc comment: 'Anything else...stays staticAbilities text until a real card needs it') — confirmed via 2 independent real pool precedents (scorpion-sentinel, gigantoad) that already made the identical call for their own identically-shaped 'as long as you control seven or more lands' buffs, neither ever got ptFormula treatment. Kept `staticAbilities` text unchanged; added a real SOURCE `{event:'pump', target:'self'}` fact (oracle-anchored, 'gets +2/+0') for the pump itself, exempted from verify-synergy's forward evidence check via a new narrowly-scoped `isGaelicatArtifactThresholdPumpFact` (verify-synergy.mjs) — same 'real fact, real documented engine gap, tolerated via a named exemption' treatment as Auron's Inspiration/Crystal Fragments/Dragoon's Lance. Also added, per this task's explicit ask, a paired SINK for the CONDITION itself (mirroring Steiner's own paired 'wants-equipment' sink for its equipment-count condition): `{to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Artifact']}, amount:{min:2}, value:-1}` — `Constraints.amount` was previously declared but never actually used by any real pool sink; this is its first real usage (documented as sink-side magnitude only, NOT consulted by satisfiesConstraints, per synergy.ts's own doc comment — a candidate-count threshold isn't something the per-candidate matcher can filter on anyway, `amount` here just correctly states the real magnitude for factTotal's own weighting). Real trace evidence: converted scenarios.ts from the old plain-Scenario style (`{result, you:{artifactsCount:2}}`, zero real reads) to a real engine-piloted trace — 2 real named fin Artifacts (Phoenix Down, Elixir) placed on the battlefield, Gaelicat cast for real {2}{W}, then TWO honest real reads: (1) `loggingCard(...).isArtifact()` on each real artifact (genuine, logged, per-object type reads — the condition is real observable board state) and (2) a real `effectivePT` read (same live layer-7a helper Steiner's own scenario uses) confirming Gaelicat's UNMODIFIED printed 1/3 even with the threshold met — chosen deliberately over fabricating a `read:getNetPower` showing a bonus that doesn't actually apply (this engine has no threshold-CDA machinery), an honest demonstration of the documented gap rather than invented evidence. Also fixed a real, independent bug found while building the scenario: definition.ts was missing `pt: [1, 3]` entirely (real printed base P/T) — without it state.ts's own addCard silently defaults to a fake 1/1, same gap class adelbert-steiner's own `pt` field already closes; scenario now reads `basePower`/`baseToughness` off `gaelicat.pt` directly rather than hardcoding literals, same convention Steiner's scenario uses. Added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS; ran compute-annotations.mjs — all 4 facts got real, verified annotations (2 typeLine-anchored 'Creature', 1 oracle-anchored 'gets +2/+0', 1 oracle-anchored 'As long as you control two or more artifacts'). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped + full pool): 0 hard failures for gaelicat (only pre-existing, pool-wide-benign `tapForMana`/no-fact-vocabulary soft notes, same as adelbert-steiner's own scoped run). vitest run functional-model: 238/238 unchanged. tsc --noEmit: no new gaelicat errors. Real find-synergies.mjs before/after diff (isolated via a temporary synergy.json swap, not a stale git-HEAD diff, since the working tree has diverged too far pool-wide for that to isolate cleanly): 131 lost / 144 gained, net +13. All 131 'lost' lines are the old bare `self-battlefield` presence fact's own outgoing matches (Gaelicat --[battlefield presence]--> X, 130 distinct real cards) — each one has an exact 1:1 replacement in the 144 'gained' lines under the new label (Gaelicat --[enters the battlefield]--> X), a pure relabeling from the self-cast/self-enters upgrade, not a real regression (same pattern every other card's own bare-presence-to-entersBattlefield migration this session already produced). The remaining 13 gained lines are genuinely NEW real incoming matches via the new `wants-artifacts` sink, now correctly recognizing Gaelicat as a real consumer of artifact-producing cards: Cargo Ship, Crystal Fragments (×2, both its own real Artifact-producing facts), Diamond Weapon, Dragoon's Lance, Iron Giant, Lunatic Pandora, Omega Heartless Evolution, Ring of the Lucii, Scorpion Sentinel, The Regalia. review reset to 'ai' (new authored-content change). NOTE: an initial mis-scoped `run-scenarios.mjs` invocation (missing `--slug=`) briefly regenerated trace.json for the entire 300+ card pool, picking up a concurrent session's in-progress edits mid-flight; caught immediately and reverted via `git checkout` for every trace.json except gaelicat's own before any verification ran, so no other card's checked-in trace.json was actually affected by this task.
knownGaps: 'As long as you control two or more artifacts, this creature gets +2/+0' is a genuine layer-7a threshold CDA with zero engine execution — no ptFormula variant exists for a fixed on/off threshold (only addPerEquipmentControlled/setToCreaturesControlled do), same real gap scorpion-sentinel's and gigantoad's own identically-shaped land-count buffs already have. The real fact exists (event:'pump') and is exempted from verify-synergy's evidence requirement via isGaelicatArtifactThresholdPumpFact, same as Auron's Inspiration/Crystal Fragments/Dragoon's Lance.

Constraints.amount on the wants-artifacts sink is real, honest data (a real min-2 threshold) but is NOT consulted by satisfiesConstraints — no pipeline filters a matching candidate by aggregate battlefield count today, same 'future full matcher unification' bucket as attacking/attachedToSelf/equippedBySelf/tapped.
